project_type: Python Streamlit app: hybrid quantum-classical traffic signal optimizer. Two entry points — app.py (NetworkX multi-intersection simulator with Folium map) and live_app.py (real-time YOLO vehicle detection on four videos driving an adaptive signal controller).
build_system: No build step. Plain Python 3.13 modules + requirements.txt. Run via `streamlit run app.py` / `streamlit run live_app.py`.
test_framework: None present. Verification is `python -m py_compile` on every module plus targeted import/run one-liners (all third-party deps are installed in this environment, so import-level checks work).
test_command: python -c "from traffic_network import TrafficNetwork; from quantum_optimizer import optimize_signals, apply_assignment; from classical_baseline import solve_fixed, solve_rule_based; from environmental import evaluate_plan, improvement; net=TrafficNetwork(6,7); net.randomize_traffic(0.5); r=optimize_signals(net); apply_assignment(net,r); m=evaluate_plan(net,r); f=solve_fixed(net); print(r.method, improvement(evaluate_plan(net,f), m))"
verification_instructions: 1) Compile every .py module (all must pass). 2) Run the app-logic chain one-liner above; it must print the annealing method and an improvement dict. 3) Run the live-chain import: python -c "import config, logger, alerts, signal_controller, savings_predictor; from video_detector import MultiVideoDetector, DIRECTIONS; from signal_controller import AdaptiveSignalController; from savings_predictor import SavingsPredictor; print('live chain OK')". 4) Do NOT launch a Streamlit server in verification. 5) For README: Select-String README.md -Pattern 'chatbot|Featherless|FEATHERLESS|openai|pages/' must return nothing. 6) For .gitignore: git check-ignore must report redlight_violations/ and .env ignored, and .env.example NOT ignored.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Runtime generates (gitignored, regenerable): traffic_log.json, traffic_logs.csv, accident_snapshots/, speed_violations/. No build-time generated files that must be committed. yolo11s.pt and accident_ncnn_model/ weights are committed as-is (each < 50MB).
environment_constraints: Windows / PowerShell: use ';' not '&&'. Operate ONLY inside the quantum_traffic_optimizer repo folder. NEVER touch the sibling '..\Jetson Orin Traffic System Backup\' folder or any parent-level *.mp4 files. NEVER delete .env from disk. qiskit 2.5.2 is installed but QISKIT_AVAILABLE resolves False (needs qiskit-algorithms + qiskit.primitives.Sampler which qiskit 2.x removed); the code's annealing fallback is the correct working behavior — do not break it. git is initialized on branch 'main' with zero commits.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md in repo. Rule from the task: cleanup + bug-fix + docs ONLY, not a rewrite. Preserve all genuinely-working functionality. Keep .env gitignored and uncommitted; commit .env.example. No remote push.
key_patterns: quantum_optimizer.py exposes build_qubo/solve_qaoa/solve_annealing/optimize_signals/apply_assignment and a QISKIT_AVAILABLE flag guarded by try/except. app.py imports traffic_network, quantum_optimizer, classical_baseline, environmental, emergency, events. live_app.py imports config, logger, alerts, signal_controller, video_detector(MultiVideoDetector, DIRECTIONS), signal_controller.AdaptiveSignalController, savings_predictor.SavingsPredictor. Streamlit container-width API is used inconsistently (app.py: use_container_width=True; live_app.py: width='stretch') — both valid in Streamlit 1.62, cosmetic only.
